subject.title: fix(compaction): prevent repeated restarts after safety timeouts

question: After sibling-runtime compatibility is restored, should a wrapper-owned safety timeout allow one explicitly marked partial compaction result to commit before its bounded acceptance token expires?
rationale: Tests and runtime proof can establish ordering and containment, but they cannot decide the intended authoritative session-state policy after a timeout has fired.

options.title: Accept bounded partial commit
options.body: Allow only the wrapper-owned typed result to persist before token expiry, preserving completed chunks without changing public timeout configuration.

options.title: Keep timeout terminal
options.body: Reject every result after timeout and pursue durable checkpoints or another pre-timeout progress mechanism instead.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded partial commit
recommendation.body: Allow only the wrapper-owned typed result to persist before token expiry, preserving completed chunks without changing public timeout configuration.
